entities.name: José da Silva Chaves
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José da Silva Chaves is a Brazilian Roman Catholic prelate who served as Bishop of the Diocese of Uruaçu in the state of Goiás from 1976 until his retirement in 2007. He previously served as auxiliary bishop and in various leadership roles within the diocese.
